description: This file defines the AutoPurgeService class responsible for automatically purging old tasks to manage disk space, including methods for task classification, size calculation, and purging logic.

classes.name: AutoPurgeService
classes.description: Service responsible for automatically purging old tasks based on settings, including methods for task classification, size calculation, and purging logic.

methods.name: purgeOldTasks
methods.description: Main method to purge old tasks based on settings, handling task eligibility, deletion, and telemetry logging.

methods.name: getTasksEligibleForPurge
methods.description: Retrieves tasks eligible for purging based on age, type, and retention settings.

methods.name: classifyTask
methods.description: Classifies a task as FAVORITED, COMPLETED, or INCOMPLETE based on its properties and completion status.

methods.name: checkTaskCompletion
methods.description: Checks if a task is completed by reading its ui_messages.json and looking for a completion message.

methods.name: getRetentionDaysForTaskType
methods.description: Returns retention days for a specific task type based on settings.

methods.name: deleteTaskFiles
methods.description: Deletes all files associated with a given task.

methods.name: getTaskSizeBytes
methods.description: Calculates the size of a task directory in bytes.

methods.name: isTaskActive
methods.description: Checks if a task is currently active.

methods.name: getTaskStorageStats
methods.description: Provides storage statistics including total size, task counts by type, and oldest/newest task timestamps.
